firm_data.firm_description: The Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA) is North America’s largest transportation network, serving a population of 15.3 million people across a 5,000-square-mile area surrounding New York City through its family of agencies: MTA New York City Transit, MTA Bus, Long Island Rail Road, Metro-North Railroad, MTA Bridges and Tunnels, and MTA Construction & Development.

email.subject: AI for MTA Long Island Rail Road, built for operations at scale
email.body:
Hi Rafail,

Managing technology across North America's largest transportation network, serving 15.3 million people, means balancing precision, reliability, and operational efficiency across multiple agencies and complex workflows. That's exactly where we see the biggest gaps in legal operations.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for organizations facing enterprise demands with distributed teams. We recently raised $5M, and transportation authorities and large operators across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us because we focus on real operational realities: document accuracy, compliance, and speed without cutting corners.

We've completed successful pilots on the East Coast and are expanding our reach. I'd be happy to spend 20 minutes showing how legal tech built for scale can support MTA's operations.

Worth a brief conversation?

Vasu
Lucio
